historical_record.description: Recorded in the city's survey of the Van Ness Avenue automobile corridor as built for use as an auto repair and tire shop 1.
Tire shops did vulcanising and retreading here for nearly thirty years, 1922–1951.
Evaluated in the city's survey of the Van Ness Avenue automobile corridor and given California Register status code 3CS — individually eligible for the California Register.
